issues.description: The problem statement (UML and textual description) specifies that Milkable.messageOnMilk() returns a boolean (should return true/false when milking), but the solution implements Milkable.messageOnMilk() with return type String and Goat/Seal return textual messages. This mismatch in the method return type is a core API inconsistency and will confuse students about the expected signature and return values.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the API: either (A) change the problem statement (UML and textual description) to specify messageOnMilk() returns String and describe the expected message format (e.g. "[AnimalType] [name] is milked"), or (B) change the solution to make Milkable.messageOnMilk() return boolean and update Goat and Seal implementations (and any tests/example code) to return true/false accordingly. Choose one option and update all artifacts (UML, problem text, template Main, solution, and tests) to match.

issues.description: The concept 'messageOnMilk()' is described in the problem statement UML and textual instructions as returning a boolean (true/false) for milking success, but in the provided solution (and the template Main usage) the same method is declared and implemented to return a String (e.g. "Goat <name> is milked"). This mismatch between the problem specification and the solution/template creates confusion about the expected API for Milkable.messageOnMilk() and may lead students to implement the wrong return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the API contract for messageOnMilk(): either (A) change the problem statement (UML and textual description) to specify messageOnMilk():String and document the expected message format (e.g. "<AnimalType> <name> is milked"), or (B) change the solution and template to implement messageOnMilk() as boolean and adjust the implementations/tests accordingly. Prefer option A to match the existing solution behavior and template usage.
